text:
sam (mktg): Heads-up: Silverpine case study interview confirmed for Thurs 11am PT. Need a 1-line customer quote + logo permission and legal OK by Tue COB so we can hit the launch post + webinar reg go-live next Wed. Recording will be uploaded by transcript-bot.

leo (content): Thanks. I'll draft two headline options: one with a concrete metric and one qualitative. Rough: "Redwood cut our P95 latency in half while lowering per-request cost." Will swap numbers after we confirm.

tanya (legal): Please flag any specific numbers or internal customer metrics. If they quote throughput or revenue impact, we need written attestation from Silverpine and the customer signoff on the final text. Also need their logo usage policy before assets go public.

andre (sales): I'll ask the AE to get attestation. Also ask Silverpine if they're comfortable with the webinar co-branded slide deck and a customer-facing Q&A.

morgan (ops): For registration routing — propose tagging registrants with `source=case_webinar` and a hidden `priority_demo` boolean. If priority_demo == true then assign to AE-Priority queue for 48hrs. Otherwise go to nurture. I'll implement in HubSpot.

nina (demand): Promo plan: 1 blog post, 2 LinkedIn posts, and an email to the benchmarks list. Publish post + reg open same time 9am PT. Need the approved quote + logo by Tue to approve creative. Also want a short 30s customer quote video clip if Silverpine can record.

sam (mktg): Tanya — can you aim for Tue COB? If legal needs sample wording, Leo will add both variants into the doc and we can share with Silverpine before the interview.

tanya (legal): Tue COB is doable if we get the copy by Mon noon. If they insist on the exact metric wording we will require the attestation André mentioned. If not, we can soften to "significant" or "multi-fold" improvement.

andre (sales): I'll try to get the attestation today. If not, authorize the softer phrasing so timelines don't slip.

leo (content): Will add both versions to the doc and indicate where the quote will be pulled into the post and webinar landing page. Also including alt CTAs for webinar: "See the benchmark details" vs "Book a priority demo" for A/B testing.

transcript-bot: Transcript uploaded: https://drive.redwood/silverpine/transcript-2143594321.txt

morgan (ops): HubSpot rules I'll add:
```
- hidden field: priority_demo (boolean)
- hidden field: source = case_webinar
- routing: if priority_demo == true -> assign AE-Priority (48h) else -> add to 14-day nurture flow
- tag: webinar_reg_ts -> timestamp
```
I'll push config Tue morning and share the flow screenshot.

nina (demand): Also request that registrants get a calendar invite with an add-on question: "Interested in Dedicated Deployment?" (yes/no). We can map that to `interested_in_dedicated`.

andre (sales): Confirmed — AE owner ok to capture `interested_in_dedicated`. Will add to attestation request to Silverpine that numbers are ok to publish.

sam (mktg): Action list: 1) André: attestation or permission to soften (today) 2) Leo: two copy variants + quote placements (Mon noon) 3) Tanya: legal review + logo terms (Tue COB) 4) Morgan: HubSpot hidden fields + routing (Tue AM) 5) Nina: promo calendar locked once assets approved. If anything blocks, tag @tanya or @andre. :thumbsup:

leo (content): Also proposed embargo: Do not publish until Silverpine sends final signoff email with logo usage and quote - we'll include stamping with an embargo timestamp.

tanya (legal): Agreed on embargo. I'll draft a short approval checklist for the customer to sign (quote, logo, video clip rights).

sam (mktg): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the interview doc with the final agenda and share the calendar invite with recording instructions.

transcript-bot: Recording link + transcript posted to drive: https://drive.redwood/silverpine/recording-2143594321.mp3
